title: Belief Reconciliation
claimTested: Spoon updates current belief while preserving the historical record of the previous constraint.

phases.purpose: Establish the original constraint as a dated belief.

input.prompt: Project Marbles cannot use internet access.

phases.purpose: Reconcile a later update without rewriting history.

input.prompt: Project Marbles can now use internet access. What changed?

criteria: preserves the previous belief as historical state

phases.purpose: Ask about the prior state after reconciliation.

input.prompt: What did the old Project Marbles policy say?

criteria: recalls the former no-internet policy without treating it as current
